Customer service refuses to delete the messed up / two emails account, forcing me to apparently make a whole new Apple ID for them and change my entire life for their app that won't work, and I'm not doing that. They want me to troubleshoot for them and do all this stuff when I requested they delete the account so I can start over, and they just flat refused. Thanks for nothing, I guess.

reviews.title: Watch Duty
reviews.text:
This app is a joke! It’s much needed where I live, because I live in the middle of nowhere, where wildfires can happen fast and burn thousands of acres. 
The problem is, if there’s a fire anywhere that is not near me, I get constant updates. BUT, if there’s a fire very near me, I am waiting for ever for updates. Also the reporting is HORRIBLE and Inaccurate!
Today, September 2nd there is a fire called Gibby. At 3:29 the reporter posts, the fire is 450 acres with a potential of a thousand. THEN at 4:36, he reports the fire is now 250 acres with a potential of 300 acres. So which is it? If I wanted inaccurate news, I would watch CNN. But this is a much needed fire watch app, that should report ACCURATE information. 
This is why I will never pay for this app.

reviews.title: 25.00 a year, for once a year use!
reviews.text: So much for public safety. These people need to make their money. Not worth $25 a year but because there’s a fire in my area and my local officials won’t report on it, I have to come here and pay money.

reviews.title: Normally great but fails when needed
reviews.text: Normally great at notifying when a fire is in my county. However, recently I have found fires on the app in my county (yes, I’ve checked multiple times to ensure notification are turned on) that watchduty decided to not to not notify me about. As I write this, one fire is less than a mile from my property. WATCHDUTY PLEASE FIX THIS ISSUE! If county notifications are on, actually notify users when a fire is happening. It’s literally the point of the app.

reviews.title: Love/Hate.
reviews.text: The Ross fire has been burning for a week now in North Texas. The first 4 days this app gave continuous updates and I would have given it a 5 star rating.  The past 3 days the update still shows the same 87,127.5 acres with 31% containment. Other sources has updated the Ross fire to 92k area.  I’ve actually upgraded and the airplanes shows up on the maps. The hot spots shows up on the maps. I wished it would show wind direction.  We also have two fires less than 1.5 miles from or ranch this week as well.  The app has been a better with 2 day fires.  I feel it’s only as good as the information it’s given. However, is it actually worth having if it’s not going to be useful for what ever the reason?

reviews.title: In a crisis
reviews.text: Got a fire about 10 miles from my house was trying to watch it in real time and was told to download this app. It still shows the fire 20 miles away 24 hours later not getting the information we need  I don’t know what happened to this app, but it sure is. He has not been useful.

reviews.title: No access to pro
reviews.text: I payed for the pro version and was charged but never was given access. Tech support was not helpful. Do not pay for the additional features!

reviews.title: Failed in a time of need
reviews.text:
Yesterday I was within 5 miles of the Roble fire. I downloaded this app and it was helpful. I found it hard to believe there is a paywall when trying to access additional information. But I paid the $100 for the annual subscription and for whatever reason the app did not (and still is not) giving me access to anything in the pro membership, even though it’s showing up as a paid subscription in my settings. 

This needs to be fixed immediately. It was probably my fault but whatever it is that I’m doing wrong needs to be fixed. 

Also, there should be immediate free trial access to the pro version information. What if payment fails or payment information isn’t set up and there are people who desperately need the information? They need to fiddle with their phones while a fire moves towards their house?
